The raw determinant identity in item 152 misses (−1)^(n+1). The first Krylov column is e_n, so expansion in that column has cofactor sign (−1)^(n+1); the remaining upper columns reduce triangularly to b,ab,…,a^(n−2)b. For n=2 and γ′=[[1,3],[2,4]], the left determinant is −3 and the displayed unsigned right determinant is 3. Independent exact-integer checks in dimensions 2–6 also recover the sign. Insert it in the algebraic identity. This does not refute transfer-factor preservation: the specified unramified η̃=(−1)^valuation is trivial on −1. Keep the raw determinant equality and its character-valued consequence distinct.
